foil-gold.purpose: Search focus border and coup-de-cœur pill.

brass.purpose: Relief title letters at rest; the extrusion steps darker brass toward #5c4216.

gold-outline.purpose: 1px outline of chips, link buttons, the tab rail; search focus ring.

gold-wash.purpose: Hover fill of chips and link buttons.

gold-rule.purpose: Hairline under rayon headings and above the footer.

walnut-carcass.purpose: Default wood of an uncoloured book.

walnut-lip.purpose: Face of the shelf plank and of the case top.

leather.purpose: Title label on the three largest spines, with weave and a double gold frame.

cloth-green.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

cloth-ultramarine.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

cloth-vermilion.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

cloth-slate.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

cloth-olive.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

cloth-wine.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

cloth-navy.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

cloth-tobacco.purpose: Rayon cloth, stored as data in data/rayons.json (couleur); colours spine, ribbon bookmark, fiche band and fiche primary button.

display.purpose: Site title « AI library » only, as two welded brass pieces resting on the case top.

headline.purpose: Rayon headings (Pale Foil) and the fiche title (Spine Foil on the band).

title-small.purpose: Section headings inside the fiche, in the rayon cloth on paper.

spine.purpose: Vertical titles on spines; lying-book titles at 1.05rem/0.05em.

label.purpose: Price and status pills; all counts (spines, chips, tabs, result) in tabular figures.

textures.name: cloth-weave
textures.value: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px)
textures.purpose: Deliberate buckram weave (--trame) on every cloth and leather surface (spines, title labels, lying books, fiche band, monograms). Not noise to remove.

textures.name: wood-grain
textures.value: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 0 2px, transparent 2px 11px, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 11px 13px, transparent 13px 23px), linear-gradient(90deg, #4c311e, #63412a 18%, #573823 52%, #684530 80%, #4a2f1c)
textures.purpose: Deliberate walnut grain of the case (--noyer); the upright uses a vertical variant with a lit inner chamfer.

textures.name: back-panel
textures.purpose: Deliberate dark walnut planks behind the books, light enough to receive the books' cast shadows; under top and side vignettes.

textures.name: shelf-plank
textures.purpose: Shelf plank (--planche-bois): lit top edge, front face, dark underside.

textures.name: case-top
textures.purpose: 20px top surface of the case seen from slightly above; the brass letters stand on it.

textures.name: spine-cap
textures.purpose: Leather head cap folded over the top of each spine.

textures.name: brass-extrusion
textures.purpose: Deliberate stepped thickness of the cast brass letters, each step the face scaled toward the case top's vanishing point (four to seven steps with the title size). Material relief, not a hard offset shadow.

shadows.name: upright-cast
shadows.purpose: Upright onto the end of the shelf.

shadows.name: plank-cast
shadows.purpose: Shelf plank onto the feet of the books.

shadows.name: spine-rest
shadows.purpose: Joint with the neighbour, then cast onto the back panel.

shadows.name: spine-open
shadows.purpose: Spine while its rayon is open.

shadows.name: title-label
shadows.purpose: Double gold frame and slight lift of the leather title label.

shadows.name: brass-letter
shadows.purpose: Short shadow of each brass letter onto the case top, with a radial contact shadow along the base.

shadows.name: fiche-drawer
shadows.purpose: Fiche drawer over a rgba(14,9,6,0.66) veil.

motion.name: book-pull
motion.purpose: Spine rises 7px on hover/focus, 12px when open (8px on phone, no hover lift); lying book slides 8px/12px left.

motion.name: letter-straighten
motion.purpose: Brass letters rotate from their tilt to 0deg on title hover.

motion.name: fiche-slide
motion.purpose: Fiche enters from 40px to the right.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations off under prefers-reduced-motion.

extensions.spineSizing: app.js sizeSpines: width = base + k × tools, one global k for all spines (base 30px, 20px under 480px of shelf), k capped so no spine exceeds its height / 2.4; reruns on resize. renderShelf gives the three largest rayons a leather title label (.piece).

components.name: Brass Title
components.description: The name in cast brass, in two welded pieces on the case top: « AI » flat on its feet, « library » leaning on its l and y. Drawn as SVG by logo.js (letters moved until they touch, rest edge from the convex hull, thickness scaled toward the case top's vanishing point); this specimen is a frozen 1280px render. Lighter brass face on hover.

narrative.overview:
The site is a binder's room at night: a dark walnut wall, one real bookcase, and on its shelf eight buckram volumes, one per rayon. Their titles are stamped in hot-foil gold small caps between double filets, the way a bindery finishes a spine; the three largest volumes carry a dark leather title label. On the top of the case, seen slightly from above, stand the brass relief letters « AI library », each set by hand at its own small tilt. Everything below the case (search, price chips, shelf-lists of tools) reads as linen text on the same walnut wall, hanging off thin gold rules. A tool's fiche is a sheet of linen paper slid out from the right, headed by a band of its rayon's cloth.

The bookcase is a functional object, not a picture. Spine thickness encodes the number of tools in each rayon; pulling a spine opens it; the lying books against the right-hand upright are the three shortcuts (Coups de cœur, Nouveautés, Proposer un outil). Density is moderate: one large object at the top, then calm lists.

The world explicitly rejects the directory pattern (a centered search hero over a grid of category cards).
keyCharacteristics: One continuous walnut bookcase: a visible top surface carrying the brass title, a back panel of dark walnut planks, a shelf plank, and a true upright on the right that caps the shelf.
Buckram spines in saturated cloth colours, woven texture, a leather head cap, gold small-caps titles and double filets; leather title labels on the three largest volumes.
Spine width proportional to tool count through one global coefficient; spine height varies slightly per volume.
Linen text on walnut for reading; linen paper with dark ink for the fiche.
Pill-shaped controls outlined in faint gold, gold fill for the selected state; sub-themes are index dividers, not pills.

rules.name: The Cloth Belongs To The Book Rule
rules.body: Saturated cloth colour appears only on things that are books or come from a book: spines, lying books, the ribbon bookmark, monograms, the fiche band and the fiche's primary button. UI chrome on the wall stays walnut, linen and gold.

rules.name: The Stamped Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is metal, never a background panel. It appears as text, filets, hairlines, outlines, the fill of a selected control and a faint hover wash on a control; never as a large tinted surface.

rules.name: The One Brass Nameplate Rule
rules.body: Brass is the cast metal of the title letters and nothing else. Every other gold on the page is foil.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Small caps mean "this is a title stamped on a book, a shelf heading, or the nameplate". Never set running text, buttons or metadata in the small-caps cut. The one small inline exception in the build is the « Coup de cœur » mark after a tool name.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that counts tools is set in tabular figures so counts align on spines, chips and tabs.

rules.name: The Global Coefficient Rule
rules.body: Spine width is base + k × tools with a single k for all spines (`sizeSpines` in app.js; base 30px, 20px when the shelf is under 480px wide), so the order of thicknesses always follows the order of counts. k is capped so that no spine is wider than its own height divided by 2.4. It reruns on resize. Spine heights come from a fixed set of ratios (0.8 to 0.98 of case height) so the row reads as real books.

rules.name: The Only The Case Is Lifted Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to the bookcase (its top, books, plank and upright, and the brass letters standing on it), the fiche drawer and the back-to-top pill. Lists, toolbars, tabs and headings stay flat on the wall.

rules.name: The Deliberate Texture Rule
rules.body: The woven cloth (`--trame`: two crossed 1px repeating linear gradients at 3px pitch), the wood grain of the case (`--noyer`), the plank seams of the back panel, the grain of the upright and the stepped extrusion of the brass letters are repeating-gradient and layered-shadow textures on purpose. They are the material of this world, rendered in CSS with no image files, and they are not noise to clean up. Every cloth and leather surface (spines, title labels, lying books, the fiche band, monograms) carries the weave.

dos: **Do** let spine width carry the tool count through the single global coefficient in `sizeSpines`; never size one spine by hand.
**Do** take rayon colours from `data/rayons.json` and reuse that one value for spine, bookmark, monogram and fiche band.
**Do** stamp titles on cloth or leather in Spine Foil small caps with double filets, and keep the woven texture on every cloth and leather surface.
**Do** keep price and action controls on the wall as Gold Outline pills, with Pale Foil fill only for the selected state; keep sub-themes as index dividers on a rail.
**Do** use tabular figures for every count.
**Do** keep the 180ms exponential ease-out for book movement and drop all motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** draw icons as inline stroked SVG (2px stroke, round caps), never as text glyphs.
donts: **Don't** turn the home into a centred search hero over a grid of category cards.
**Don't** put cloth colours on wall chrome (toolbar, lists, headings, tabs); they belong to books.
**Don't** set body text, buttons or metadata in the small-caps cut.
**Don't** add shadows to flat wall elements; only the case and what stands on it, the fiche and the back-to-top pill are lifted.
**Don't** use brass anywhere but the title letters.
**Don't** replace the repeating-gradient cloth, wood and plank textures or the brass extrusion with flat fills or raster images.
